title: cnicus stellatus
intro: Cnicus stellatus, commonly known as Star Thistle or Corn Marigold, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family that is native to Europe and Asia. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cnicus stellatus are believed to be due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive discomfort and alleviate respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
